newsitem.title: USA: CompUSA Inc Q3 same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: CompUSA Inc Q3 same-store sales up.

text.p: CompUSA Inc said Wednesday its comparable-store sales rose 5.6 percent in the fiscal third quarter ended March 29, representing the 10th consecutive quarter of positive comparable-store sales.
Net sales increased 19.4 percent, to $1.27 billion from $1.07 billion a year ago, the company said.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, comparable-store sales were up 4.6 percent and net sales rose 22.3 percent, to $3.46 billion from $2.83 billion a year earlier.
CompUSA is a retailer and reseller of personal computers and related products and services.
